question: Which species is the heaviest on average? Show a bar chart of average body mass by species.
sql:
SELECT
  "species",
  AVG(TRY_CAST("body_mass_g" AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_body_mass_g
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    *
  FROM penguins_csv
) AS "penguins_csv"
WHERE
  NOT "body_mass_g" IS NULL AND TRIM("body_mass_g") <> ''
GROUP BY
  "species"
ORDER BY
  avg_body_mass_g DESC
spec:
$schema: https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json
config:
  axis:
    grid: false
  numberFormat: ',~r'
  view:
    stroke: null
height: container
layer:
- encoding:
    color:
      condition:
        test: datum.species === 'Gentoo'
        value: '#1f77b4'
      value: '#aec7e8'
    tooltip:
    - field: species
      title: Species
      type: nominal
    - field: avg_body_mass_g
      format: ',.0f'
      title: Avg Body Mass (g)
      type: quantitative
    x:
      axis:
        title: null
      field: species
      sort:
        field: avg_body_mass_g
        order: descending
      type: nominal
    y:
      axis:
        format: ',~r'
        title: Avg Body Mass (g)
      field: avg_body_mass_g
      type: quantitative
  mark: bar
title:
  subtitle: 37% heavier than Chinstrap or Adelie
  text: Gentoo Is the Heaviest Species on Average
width: container
